title: Asian Games: Agatha Wong finishes 10th place in taijiquan and taijijian
summary: Agatha Wong finished 10th place in the wushu taijiquan and taijijian event of the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Games, Sunday held at the Aichi Prefectural Martial Arts Hall.
